release_name: Live TV v5.5.0 (Build 68) — Rolex Paris Masters & Setanta Sports Enterprise Update
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🎾 Rolex Paris Masters Official Coverage: Added dedicated ATP Paris Masters Live HD channel featuring live multi-court center feeds (Court 1 & Court 2) with high-bitrate Setanta Sports live commentary.
📺 Setanta Sports 1 & 2 HD: Integrated 24/7 dedicated Setanta Sports 1 and Setanta Sports 2 Eurasia channels with 1080p 60fps streaming and zero geo-blocking.
⚡ Enhanced Cross-Platform HTTPS Priority: High-resilience HTTPS streams with permissive CORS headers prioritized across GitHub Pages web app, native macOS, and Android.
📺 1080p FHD Default Playback: All 3,011 channels automatically launch in pristine 1080p FHD resolution with adaptive bitrate caps disabled.
🏗️ Microservices Architecture: Fully decoupled modular architecture across macOS Native, Android Native, and Web Core.
